prompt: What does this company do and how many employees does it have?
text:
Autumn AI builds a source-backed research platform for people and companies. Its agents connect public records, professional profiles, code, news and other web evidence to resolve identities, map relationships and produce cited company and person profiles, supporting use cases like startup discovery, prospect research and cohort search via its interface and API.

It has 2 employees.
